sourceDocuments.title: Biochemistry of Carbon Fixation
sourceDocuments.text: Photosynthetic carbon fixation occurs through the Calvin cycle within the stroma of chloroplasts. Ribulose-1,5-bisphosphate carboxylase-oxygenase catalyzes the primary carboxylation reaction fixing atmospheric carbon dioxide into 3-phosphoglycerate.

studentDocument.title: Plant Energy Transduction
studentDocument.text: In biological systems, photosynthesis is essential for life on Earth. Photosynthetic carbon fixation occurs through the Calvin cycle within the stroma of chloroplasts. This concludes our introduction to plant biochemistry.
